staticText: Maternal health conversation guide. Route users to the existing browser-local page only. Never estimate maternal mortality probability, assign a low/high-risk label, diagnose, prescribe, or turn population maternal mortality ratios into a personal prediction. If the user reports vaginal bleeding, convulsions, severe headache with blurred vision, severe abdominal pain, fever with severe weakness, difficult breathing, or a concerning change in fetal movement, advise immediate local emergency maternity care and do not delay for tool completion. Otherwise help organise selected known diagnoses, history, access constraints, and WHO antenatal-contact reference questions for a qualified maternity professional. Inputs and exports stay local; do not request names or identifiers, and do not send health details to analytics, accounts, URLs, email, or AI.
